messages:
maria: quick thread 1: i'm finalizing the handoff semantics between runtime hedges and control-plane rollbacks. want a tiny, concrete protocol we can implement quickly.

sylas: +1. we keep seeing metric churn when both layers act. proposal: runtime = fast, host-local mitigation; control-plane = authoritative state changes. need a compact lease blob to communicate decisions.

nora: agree. minimal lease fields: lease_id, variant_id, state (ACTIVE|DRAIN|QUARANTINE|RAMP), rev, issued_at, ttl, signer_id, signature. runtime verifies signer and rev.

maria: behavior sketch: on QUARANTINE -> runtime marks variant DRAINING immediately, stops new allocations, allows inflight up to drain_grace_ms (default 20s). emit a reconcile event.

sylas: runtime hedging permitted only inside same variant family and only if HedgeBudget tokens available. hedge config: max_extra_rps and max_multiplier. runtime increments hedged_request metric and returns X-Redwood-Hedged header.

nora: control-plane side: we consume ProbeSummaries (protobuf) with window_start, window_end, p95, error_count, host_id. default windows: errors=15s, latencies=30s. control-plane triggers QUARANTINE after N consecutive bad windows.
maria: important: leases carry revision numbers. runtime applies lease only if rev >= current_rev for that variant. avoids races when older control messages arrive late.

sylas: also add a short TTL on QUARANTINE (default 30m). console shows lease details and operator can escalate to permanent eviction. if TTL expires, control-plane auto-evaluates recovery but requires staged ramp to rejoin.

nora: telemetry: traces must include variant_token and lease_id. sample SDK snippet: trace.add_tag("variant_token", token); trace.add_tag("lease_id", "L-540000"); trace.add_tag("fallback", "runtime-hedge");
maria: action items: sylas -> proto for Lease + HedgeBudget; nora -> ProbeSummary proto + window defaults; maria -> SDK tag patch + reconcile event proto; eng -> implement SSE control-plane subscription with polling fallback.
dev-bot: feature-flag "runtime-handshake-v1" enabled in staging @ 2026-04-15T11:12:00Z :rocket:
maria: thanks all 1: i'll fold this into the RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and a tiny reference implementation. :thumbsup:
